common: Create a polished game UI mockup contact sheet for BUY, BID, BLOW. Exactly four separate 16:9 game screenshots arranged in a clean 2 by 2 grid, narrow dark gutters, each screenshot fully visible. High resolution, readable Korean UI typography, not a wireframe. Use the supplied images ONLY as style references: warm low-poly wooden auction hall, cute angular wolves in suits and pig staff, smoky dark teal translucent panels, restrained aged brass borders, warm ivory bold text, walnut and brass buttons, selected button brighter gold, others muted. Dim backgrounds behind modals, avoid ornamental overload and neon. Keyboard-only prompts [←→] [Enter] [Esc], no mouse cursors. This sheet should have its own small sheet title and a distinct short caption above each quadrant. Interface layout is primary, environments secondary. Keep text short and exact, clear visual hierarchy. No unrelated UI, no watermarks.

boards.title: 경기 흐름
boards.detail:
Top left caption "01 최종 결과": large centered results panel with heading "최종 결과", "17 / 17 ROUND", a small winning wolf portrait and crown, 3-player table columns "순위 / 플레이어 / 총자산 / 현금 / 주식 평가 / 보유 주식", rows "1 루나 $620 $260 $360 12주", "2 모카 $540 $180 $360 10주", "3 로이 $480 $200 $280 8주". Local row subtly highlighted. Small line "동점 시 보유 주식 수 비교 · 동일하면 공동 순위". Buttons "로비로 돌아가기", footer "호스트의 복귀를 기다립니다". Only final scoreboard reveals endgame data.
Top right "02 로딩": full screen dim illustrated hall, small central hourglass or envelope icon, heading "경매장으로 이동 중", bottom thin loading progress bar and "플레이어 준비 2 / 3", one short tip.
Bottom left "03 경기 시작 대기": in-game 1st-person hall with persistent small asset HUD top left and round timer top right, central slim panel "플레이어를 기다리는 중" and three small wolf portraits, 2 ready and 1 pending, "2 / 3 준비 완료", no countdown before all ready.
Bottom right "04 일시정지 메뉴": dim gameplay with narrow centered vertical menu "메뉴", buttons "계속하기", "설정", "조작 안내", "방 나가기"; top gold selected continue. Clear note "온라인 경기는 계속 진행됩니다".

boards.title: 접속 상태
boards.detail:
All four share one restrained centered smoky teal connection modal over dim lobby or in-game hall. Top left "05 접속 중": heading "대기실에 접속 중", small rotating hourglass, label "주소 localhost", single button "취소".
Top right "06 접속 실패": heading "접속할 수 없습니다", small disconnected plug icon in muted red, "서버가 응답하지 않습니다." and "주소와 호스트 상태를 확인해주세요.", buttons "다시 시도", "돌아가기".
Bottom left "07 연결 끊김": frozen dim gameplay behind modal, heading "연결이 끊겼습니다", subtext "호스트와의 연결이 종료되었습니다.", sole button "메인 메뉴로". Do not show reconnect buttons or countdowns.
Bottom right "08 호스트 종료": same family, quiet dark gold door icon, heading "방이 종료되었습니다", text "호스트가 방을 종료했습니다.", sole button "메인 메뉴로". No reconnect. These are informational messages, not scary red emergency dialogs.

boards.title: 확인과 입장 제한
boards.detail:
Top left "09 방 나가기 확인": compact central modal heading "방을 나가시겠습니까?", text "진행 중인 경기를 떠납니다.", two buttons "취소" gold focused, "나가기" muted red accent. Do not invent penalties.
Top right "10 정원 초과": compact informational modal heading "방이 가득 찼습니다", simple 6 wolf silhouette badge "6 / 6", text "다른 방에 접속해주세요.", button "돌아가기".
Bottom left "11 경기 진행 중": heading "이미 경기가 시작되었습니다", small closed envelope/door icon, text "현재 이 방에 입장할 수 없습니다.", button "돌아가기". No spectator or reconnection feature.
Bottom right "12 공통 오류 팝업": heading "요청을 처리할 수 없습니다", concise text "잠시 후 다시 시도해주세요.", expandable looking small optional "상세 정보" row, button "확인". Same popup component proportions as other three; no technical stack traces.

boards.title: 라운드와 경매
boards.detail:
Use uncluttered first-person hall or seated auction view. Top left "13 라운드 시작": normal gameplay, top-left compact asset HUD, top-right horizontal "3 / 17 ROUND 01:00", a brief narrow centered banner "3 ROUND" "거래를 시작하세요"; central view and bottom interaction area clear.
Top right "14 라운드 마감": same HUD, timer "00:00", centered banner "거래 마감" smaller "주가를 정산하고 있습니다", market board in background, subdued controls, no future price disclosure.
Bottom left "15 공개 경매 결과": seated view of black-hat pig auctioneer, simple cream envelope under hemispherical glass cloche, existing corner HUD. A compact teal result plaque above bottom controls: "낙찰" "루나 · $35", next line "정보는 낙찰자만 확인할 수 있습니다." No actual secret directions. Alternative small tag "무입찰 시 유찰".
Bottom right "16 비공개 경매 결과": same seated scene but private modal "입찰 결과" "낙찰 성공" smaller "내 입찰금 $40", button "정보 확인". Explicitly no winner name, no other bids, no other players' outcomes. A small separate noninteractive comparison thumbnail inside the same quadrant can say "미낙찰" with no person or amount; clearly label it as alternate state.

boards.title: 개인 정보와 알림
boards.detail:
Top left "17 획득 정보": modal on dim gameplay titled "정보를 획득했습니다", an ivory paper inset with two rows "6R  Straw ↑ 상승 · Timber ↓ 하락" and "9R  Timber → 보합 · Brick ↑ 상승". Rising direction dark red, falling deep blue, flat graphite, matching notebook colored-pencil style. Footer "나만 확인할 수 있는 정보", buttons "수첩 열기", "닫기". 
Top right "18 베팅 성공": ordinary gameplay corner HUD remains; a compact toast directly below top-left assets, not center modal, heading "하락 베팅 성공", line "Timber · 참가 $40", large "$80 수령", small "순이익 +$40". Low-key success design without confetti.
Bottom left "19 베팅 실패": same discreet toast placement "하락 베팅 실패", "Timber · 상승 또는 보합", "참가금 $40 손실". Do not disclose other players' bets.
Bottom right "20 거래와 요청 알림": normal trading panel right, pig merchant left. Two small toast design examples stacked with clear state captions: success "매수 완료 · Straw 2주 / -$32" and failure "거래 불가 · 시장 재고가 부족합니다". No giant dialog; visible but does not cover quantity or confirmation controls.

boards.title: 설정과 안내
boards.detail:
Top left "21 설정": medium centered smoky teal panel titled "설정", top tabs "사운드 / 조작 / 화면", sound tab selected. Three slim brass sliders labeled "전체 음량 80", "배경음 40", "효과음 70". Bottom buttons "기본값", "적용", "닫기", short keyboard footer "↑↓ 항목 · ←→ 조절 · Esc 닫기". Small visible secondary row "마우스 감도" but don't overload.
Top right "22 조작 안내": ivory file-folder insert matching existing tutorial, heading "조작 안내", a clean two-column keycap/action table "WASD 이동", "마우스 시점", "Space 점프", "E 상호작용 / 확인", "I 정보 수첩", "Esc 닫기 / 메뉴", "←→ 수량 / 입찰금", no mouse pointer. One "닫기" button.
Bottom left "23 크레딧": ivory clipped document on teal folder, title "CREDITS", sections "제작팀", "아트 · 프로그래밍 · 사운드", "사용 에셋과 사운드", empty clearly-placeholder attribution rows "사운드명 · 제작자 · 라이선스", small "↑↓ 스크롤", button "닫기". Do not invent real creators or licenses.
Bottom right "24 참가 · 이탈 알림": lobby background six player slots, only discreet right-side toast stack showing "루나님이 참가했습니다" with small plus/person icon, "로이님이 퇴장했습니다" muted icon, and a separate small in-game toast sample "로이님의 연결이 종료되었습니다". No invented policy for what happens to their assets. Keep most of scene clear.
